rows.text: returns when `rcx` is null or when word `rcx+0x4` (n) is 3 or more (signed); otherwise, in the 8-byte slot at `rcx + n*8 + 0xC`: when `edx` is 0 stores dword 0 at the slot, `r8w` at its `+0x4` and `r9w` at its `+0x6`; when `edx` is 1 stores dword 1 at the slot and `r8d` at its `+0x4`; for any other `edx` stores nothing; on all three paths it then increments word `rcx+0x4`
does nothing when `rcx` is null; otherwise clears bits 0 and 1 of dword `rcx+0x8`, stores word 0 at `+0x4` and zeroes the three qwords at `+0xC`, `+0x14` and `+0x1C`
